svg.title: Page frames over time for one possible random-replacement run: 3 frames give 9 page faults and 4 frames give 10 on the string 1 2 3 4 1 2 5 1 2 3 4 5, so random replacement shows Belady anomaly
svg.text: Reference string 1 2 3 4 1 2 5 1 2 3 4 5; every victim below is a legal random choice
More frames, more faults: 10 with 4 frames against 9 with 3. Shaded columns are faults (F), H is a hit.
Random replacement may pick the oldest page each time, so this run is possible and it shows the anomaly.
